title: Senior Frontend Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**
 We are looking for a talented
 **Senior Frontend/UI Developer** 
 to build modern, responsive, and user\-friendly web applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in
 **React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern UI frameworks**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and maintain responsive web applications using React.js and Next.js.
* Build reusable, scalable, and maintainable UI components.
* Translate UI/UX designs into high\-quality production\-ready code.
* Develop applications using TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML5, and CSS3\.
* Integrate frontend applications with REST APIs and backend services.
* Optimize applications for speed, scalability, SEO, and performance.
* Ensure cross\-browser compatibility and responsive design.
* Write clean, modular, and testable code following industry best practices.
* Participate in architecture discussions and technical design reviews.
* Conduct code reviews and mentor junior developers.
* Troubleshoot production issues and implement fixes.


**Requirements**
 Required Skills:
   

  

* React.js
* Next.js
* TypeScript
* JavaScript (ES6\+)
* HTML5
* CSS3 / SCSS / SASS/ Tailwind CSS
* Jest / Vitest / React Testing Library


 Good to Have
   

  

* Node.js
* Ant Design
* Cypress
* Micro Frontend Architecture
* React Query / TanStack Query
